title: Keyboard shortcuts
intro: Shortcuts work while the app window is focused. Ctrl also means ⌘ on a Mac.

local.treeRename: Rename the selected item in the folder tree
local.treeTrash: Delete the selected item in the folder tree (to the trash)
local.openNewTab: Open the selected note in a new tab (folder tree, search)
local.closeOverlay: Close the open panel or dialog

editor.tickTask: Tick or untick the task at the caret (on a note link: open it in a new tab; on a #tag: search for that tag)

screens.stripDay: Previous or next day in the strip
screens.stripEnds: First or last day of the strip
screens.calendarWeek: Same day in the previous or next week
screens.calendarWeekEnds: Start or end of the week
screens.calendarOpen: Open the selected day in the side pane
